paper_title: MARBLE A Hard Benchmark for Multimodal Spatial Reasoning and Planning
caption: Performance of GPT-o4-mini on with binary or detailed feedback from solution validator. On , the performance will remain 0%.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the accuracy percentage of GPT-o4-mini over multiple rounds of conversation, with feedback provided in either binary or detailed formats. The x-axis represents the “Round of Conversation,” utilizing a linear scale ranging from 1 to 5, with tick labels spaced at intervals of one. The y-axis represents “Accuracy (%)” and employs a linear scale ranging from approximately 10% to 25%, with tick marks spaced at increments of two or five percentage points. A solid orange line, marked with circular markers, starts at a value of approximately 17% at Round 1 and increases to approximately 23% at Round 5, exhibiting a generally upward trend. A dashed blue line, also marked with circular markers, begins at approximately 11% at Round 1 and rises to approximately 21% at Round 5, showing a similar upward trend.
